CLOSE TO AMENITIES AND TRAVEL LINKSCOUNCIL TAX BAND : B & EPC RATING : C Description Welcome to this charming three-bedroom mid-terraced home, perfectly situated in the desirable Mayflower Close, South Ockendon. This property offers a wonderful opportunity for those seeking a comfortable and well-appointed residence, ideal for families or professionals looking for a welcoming community. Upon entering, you are greeted by a practical downstairs cloakroom, a convenient addition for any busy household. The heart of the home is undoubtedly the modern, light-filled lounge, providing a superb space for relaxation and entertaining. Adjacent to this, the fitted kitchen offers ample storage solutions, ensuring a functional and organised culinary environment. The property benefits from gas radiator heating, contributing to a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the year. Ascending to the first floor, you will find three well-proportioned bedrooms. These are complemented by a contemporary family bathroom. Outside, the property benefits from street parking and a rear garden with convenient access, perfect for outdoor enjoyment and al fresco dining. Mayflower Close is ideally located, offering excellent access to local amenities, reputable schools, and convenient transport links, making daily commutes and errands straightforward. This home presents a fantastic opportunity to reside in a sought-after area. We're here to guide, not pressure, and believe in helping you find a home, not just a property. Contact M&P Estates today to arrange your viewing and experience all that this delightful home has to offer. The Council Tax Band is B and the EPC Rating is C.
